spans.s:
ईप्स् ईप्स् (Desid. of rt. आप्, q. v.), to wish
to obtain.
ईप्सन, अम्, n. desiring, wishing to obtain.
ईप्सा, f. asking, desire, wish to obtain.
ईप्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished, desired.

ईप्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, striving to obtain; wishing to get
or obtain, desirous of (with acc.).
—ईप्सु-यज्ञ, अस्,
m. a particular Soma sacrifice.
